notes.title: fixes update 20/02/2021
notes.content:
- fixed issue preventing unlocking the "collateral dammage" success (spotted by Hanni)
- fixed typos in the success descriptions (spotted by Hanni)
- fixed word in french in the english version in the description in the backpack in the island scene (spotted by Hanni)

- fix issue with the collision sound of amosis with the door (ego ending)
- add option in main menu in order to set the brightness
- fixed issue with ghosts cubes

notes.title: fixes update 12/02/2021
notes.content:
- adapt teleportation system in order to prevent users with no room scale to be stucked in a wall
- fix issue with controller that may vibrate near constantly  (chapter 2)
- trigger automatically the guard dialogue if the player is already in the trigger zone
- fix issue in the temple, there was no more sound when breaking propaganda leaflets
- fix issue in the soldier's dream, voices volume was higher than in other parts of the game
- fix issue during the riddle in front of the temple where desassembling the assemblage would not happen correctly
- rebake lights to improve braseros
- fix issue with erratic behaviors with objects when grabbed when the SteamVR menu is called or when the headset is removed
- and of course, fix random bugs occuring when fixing other bugs

notes.title: release patch 05/02/2021
notes.content:
- fix problem with save system where you could get stuck at splashscreen after leaving the game during Market 2 or Museum 2
- fix problem in the end scene, after the moon interaction, you could stay instead of going back to the main menu
- fix problem in the market, with the lion riddle, if you use the puck from the torch riddle to open the first gate near the lion and use the column orichalcum piece to activate the second mechanism, the sound feedback of the gate is playing in spite of staying open
- fix problem in the market, with the lion riddle, if you use the puck from the torch riddle to open the first gate near the lion, you can pick up the piece of orichalcum by hand and the column destruction animation does not start
- fix problem in the market, after the scepter riddle completion, you walk toward the lion altar and meet Danae who is frozen in her waiting animation and does not talk
- fix problem with controller rumbling near constantly (chapter 1)
- fix problem after finishing the game, in the main menu, continue button loops to the main menu. should be the wave scene
- fix problem with the blackbox staying active after the soldier's dream if you keep your hands on your head during loading
- and of course, fix random bugs occuring when fixing other bugs

notes.title: update patch 30/01/2021
notes.content:
- fixed issue with backpack in the dessert, blocking game progression
- once, the lion statue at the market could not be raised by inserting the ceremonial scepter into the box in front of it. Nothing happened, I had to reload.
- when escaping the market after the forge scene, the priestess held out her hand for me to take. but that didn't work
- while trying to solve the geometric riddle by assembling the variously shaped pieces, the hammer-type base tool and another shape fell to the floor and never reappeared on the case. They weren't visible on the floor either. Again, need to reload
- in the forge scene, there is no tatoo on the left arm
- in the baracks, when pulling the double bottom, every propaganda tracts inside the chest will break
- repulsion bracelet will rool to the back of the room after falling on the ground
- when opening the gate after the lion puzzle, Danae runs in front of a wall near the haystack and stays stucked there
- post process is missing. there has been switching with Oculus SDK
- zeolithe is picked up but no accounted for
- objects (cubes & triangles) dissociate from the hammer/scepter handle, as its ghost will too. (true for the fountain on the island and for the quays)
- in the temple, if I place one or more statues in their socket and I go back to the main menu and then continue playing, the box do open but there is not the 2nd half of the medalion anymore
- and of course, fix random bugs occuring when fixing other bugs

See you next friday for the next patch
